title: Page 73
transc:
Ft. Monroe April 20 1864
Maj Eckert Di
for Negus grapes unity I have reliable Sutton from
Galway that paradise Dale greens body has been taken
possession of by his Weston friends & is put
beyond the reach torch walpole author it is zodiac
I propose to take Stephen matter the course indicated
in my last conversation with you zebra please advise
me if you wish any other walrus Knox Rosetta
Geo D Sheldon


Ft Monroe April 20 1864
Maj Eckert Di
for Indian berry growl zebra Having sent plank of my
colored whips to Vernon look out because of their fidelity
as saddles that breaks up my Quincy of colored whisky
zodiac may I request to be sent me peach colored
whartons to supply their place sugar there are plank in
Acton which perhaps might be spared webster Knave Rebecca dark
Geo D. Sheldon


Washington April 20 1864
Geo D Sheldon F Monroe
Rosetta for Knox unity receive all the
sick & wounded the confederate authorities will
send you but send Know more in
exchange yoke June hope this is last
T. T. Eckert
